title: user.session_expired
description: A session reached its expiry without being revoked: its refresh token can no longer be used, so the session has ended. Emitted once per session by the expiry sweep (stapel_auth.tasks.sweep_expired_sessions), some time after expires_at. Sibling of user.session_revoked, which is reserved for sessions ended by an action (sign-out, revoke, admin, reuse detection); a consumer that cleans up per-session state subscribes to both.
